questions.question: The first Partition of Bengal took place in the year _____
questions.solution:
• The first partition of Bengal was held on 19th July 1905.
 
• It was announced by Lord Curzon who was the viceroy of India at that time.
 
• The partition made two separate provinces, the Bengal and the Eastern Bengal which also contained Assam province.
 
• The partition of Bengal was annulled in 1911 and Lord Hardinge II was the viceroy of India at that time.

questions.question: Who became the first bowler in the history of T20 cricket to reach the milestone of 700 wickets?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashid Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 16, 2026, Afghanistan captain Rashid Khan became the first bowler to reach 700 wickets in T20 cricket history.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Landmark:** Rashid Khan achieved this historic feat during an **ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026** group-stage match against the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)** at the **Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi**.
 
• **The 700th Wicket:** The milestone wicket was UAE's **Muhammad Arfan**, who was dismissed in a unique **hit-wicket** fashion while attempting a reverse sweep in the 16th over.
 
• **Efficiency:** Rashid reached the 700-wicket mark in just **513 innings**, maintaining a remarkable bowling average of approximately **18.51**.
 
• **Global Context:** He is well ahead of his closest competitors. Retired West Indies legend **Dwayne Bravo** sits second with 631 wickets, followed by **Sunil Narine** in third place with 613 wickets.
 
• **T20I Record:** In addition to his overall T20 tally (which includes franchise leagues like the IPL), Rashid remains the leading wicket-taker in **T20 Internationals (T20Is)** with over 190 wickets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Top T20 Wicket Takers (as of Feb 2026)__**

questions.question: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST) celebrated its ____ Foundation Day in February 2026.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**23rd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST) celebrated its 23rd Foundation Day in New Delhi on 19 February 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The 23rd Foundation Day was celebrated at the Civil Services Officers Institute, Vinay Marg, New Delhi.**
 
• Union Tribal Affairs Minister Shri Jual Oram graced the occasion as the Chief Guest.
 
• The “NCST Handbook” and a Magazine documenting activities from July to December 2025 were released during the event.
 
• The Commission showcased key initiatives related to tribal empowerment, forest rights, education, health and livelihoods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST):** A constitutional body established under Article 338A of the Constitution of India to safeguard the rights and interests of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• **Scheduled Tribes:** Communities recognized under Article 342 of the Constitution, entitled to specific safeguards and development measures.
 
• **Foundation Day:** Marks the establishment of the Commission and reflects its mandate to monitor safeguards, inquire into complaints and advise on socio-economic development of tribal communities.
 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs:** The nodal ministry responsible for policy formulation and implementation of programmes for the welfare and development of Scheduled Tribes in India.

questions.question: Which country announced plans to deploy 8 exaflop supercomputers in India to strengthen sovereign AI infrastructure?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**United Arab Emirates.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The United Arab Emirates (UAE) announced plans to deploy 8 exaflop-scale AI supercomputers in India.**
 
• The announcement was made during the AI Impact Summit 2026 in Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The supercomputer will have a peak compute capacity of 8 exaflops, marking a transition to exaflop-scale AI infrastructure in India.
 
• The system will operate under India-defined governance frameworks with full data sovereignty.
 
• The project will be delivered by Abu Dhabi-based G42 and Cerebras in partnership with MBZUAI and C-DAC.
 
• The initiative aligns with the India AI Mission to enhance domestic AI development capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Exaflop:** A unit of computing performance equal to one quintillion (10¹⁸) floating-point operations per second.
 
• **Sovereign AI Infrastructure:** Refers to domestically controlled AI systems ensuring data security, regulatory compliance, and reduced dependence on foreign hyperscalers.
 
• **G42:** A global technology group based in Abu Dhabi focused on artificial intelligence and advanced computing solutions.
 
• **India AI Mission:** A national initiative aimed at strengthening India’s AI ecosystem through infrastructure, research, and innovation support.

questions.question: In which year was Gender Budgeting formally adopted by the Government of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2005–06.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Gender Budgeting was formally adopted by the Government of India in 2005–06 as a tool to promote gender equality and women empowerment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Gender Budgeting is a fiscal strategy to translate the Government’s commitment towards Gender Equality and Women Empowerment (GEWE) into budgetary allocations.
 
• It was institutionalized in the Union Budget starting from 2005–06.
 
• Central Ministries and Departments were mandated to establish Gender Budgeting Cells (GBCs).
 
• The concept received policy backing under the National Policy for Empowerment of Women, 2001.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Gender Budgeting** is not a separate budget but an approach to ensure gender-sensitive planning and allocation of public resources.
 
• It aims to address gender disparities and promote inclusive development.
 
• The principle of gender equality is enshrined in the Indian Constitution under the Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy, and Fundamental Duties.
 
• Union Budget 2026–27 allocated** ₹5.01 lakh crore for women and girls’ welfare**, an **11.55% increase **from ₹4.49 lakh crore last year.
 
• Gender Budget’s share of total budget rises to 9.37%, up from 8.86% in the previous year.
 
• Reporting reaches record high: 53 ministries/departments and 5 UTs made gender allocations, with 4 new ministries joining this fiscal.

questions.question: Which of the following is known as Brown coal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lignite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lignite**, also known as **Brown Coal**, is a type of coal that has a lower carbon content and higher moisture content compared to other types of coal.
 
• Lignite is considered the lowest rank of coal due to its relatively low heat content and high levels of impurities.
 
• It is primarily used as a fuel for electricity generation in power plants, especially in regions where it is abundantly available.
 
• Lignite deposits are generally found near the Earth's surface, making them easier to mine compared to higher-grade coals.
 
• Countries with significant lignite reserves include Germany, the United States, Russia, and Australia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coal Classification:** Coal is classified into four main types based on carbon content: Anthracite (highest rank), Bituminous, Sub-bituminous, and Lignite (lowest rank).
 
• **Anthracite:** Known as the highest rank of coal, it has the highest carbon content and is primarily used for heating and metallurgical processes.
 
• **Bituminous Coal:** A middle-rank coal, widely used for electricity generation and industrial purposes due to its relatively high energy content.
 
• **Environmental Impact:** Burning lignite releases higher levels of pollutants, including carbon dioxide and sulfur compounds, compared to higher-grade coals.
 
• **Formation Process:** Lignite forms from peat under moderate pressure and temperature conditions during the initial stages of coalification.

questions.question: Which state has declared tidal flooding along its coastline as a State-specific disaster?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kerala has declared tidal flooding along its coastline a State-specific disaster, enabling affected families to receive financial assistance under the State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala is the first state in India to officially recognise tidal flooding as a State-specific disaster. **
 
• Tidal flooding occurs when the Arabian Sea temporarily rises above a set threshold and inundates low-lying coastal areas. 
 
• The declaration allows victims to receive relief similar to other natural disasters under the SDRF. 
 
• Areas prone to frequent tidal floods include regions along Kerala’s coastline such as Vypin and Chellanam. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tidal Flooding**__

 __
 
• Occurs when sea levels rise temporarily above normal during high tides, especially during full and new moon phases.
 
• Also known as “sunny day flooding” or “nuisance flooding.” 
 
 
 
• **State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)**__
 __
 
• A fund constituted by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to states for disaster relief and rehabilitation. 
 
 
 
• **State-specific disaster**__
 
 
• A disaster category that a state government can declare under the Disaster Management Act if a natural phenomenon causes significant damage to life and property.

questions.question: Which union ministry organized the ‘Bharat Bodhan AI Conclave 2026’ in New Delhi to discuss the AI-driven transformation of India's ecosystem?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education.**__

__
 
• **The ‘Bharat Bodhan AI Conclave 2026’ was organised by the Ministry of Education and concluded in New Delhi on February 13, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Objective:** The conclave aimed to foster a collective commitment towards a responsible **AI-driven transformation** of India’s education system, specifically focusing on school education.
 
• **Focus Areas:** Discussions revolved around **Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN)**, teacher effectiveness, governance efficiency, and multilingual inclusion.
 
• **Participants:** The event saw participation from policymakers, state governments, researchers, and over 120 exhibitors showcasing AI-enabled innovations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

• Leadership__
 
 
• The debriefing session included key figures like **Shri Sanjay Kumar** (Secretary, School Education & Literacy) and **Dr. Vineet Joshi** (Secretary, Higher Education).

questions.question: Which of the following was not in the Preamble of the original Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is - __Secular__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Secular__**

 __
 
• The term **"Secular"__** was not included in the original Preamble of the Constitution of India adopted on **__26th November 1949__**.
 
• It was later added to the Preamble by the **__42nd Amendment Act of 1976__**, along with the terms **__"Socialist"__** and **__"Integrity"__**.
 
• In the context of the Indian Constitution, **__"Secular"__** signifies that the State has no official religion and treats all religions equally.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Original Preamble of the Indian Constitution__**

 __
 
• The original Preamble described India as a **Sovereign Democratic Republic__**.
 
• It aimed to secure **__Justice__**, **__Liberty__**, **__Equality__**, and **__Fraternity__** for all citizens.
 
 
 
• **__Amendments to the Preamble__**
 __
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act of 1976__**, enacted during the Emergency period, introduced the words **__Socialist__**, **__Secular__**, and **__Integrity__** to the Preamble.
 
• These additions emphasized the ideological commitment to equality, religious neutrality, and national unity.
 
 
 
• **__Importance of the Preamble__**
 __
 
• The Preamble serves as the **guiding philosophy__** of the Indian Constitution, reflecting its fundamental values and objectives.
 
• Though not legally enforceable, it is used as an aid in interpreting constitutional provisions.

questions.question: The India–France National Centre of Excellence in Aeronautics at Kanpur is being set up under which scheme?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Prime Minister announced the establishment of the India–France National Centre of Excellence in Aeronautics at Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh under the PM-SETU scheme.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Centre will be established at National Skill Training Institute (NSTI), Kanpur in collaboration with the Government of France.**
 
• It will focus on advanced skill training in aeronautics, MRO, airport operations and defence manufacturing.
 
• The initiative builds upon the India–France Strategic Partnership and a 2025 MoU in skill development and vocational training.
 
• PM-SETU has an overall outlay of ₹60,000 crore to upgrade 1000 ITIs across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **PM-SETU:** A flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship aimed at modernising ITIs and aligning training with industry requirements.
 
• **National Centre of Excellence (NCoE):** A specialised institution designed to deliver high-quality, industry-integrated vocational education and advanced skill training.
 
• **Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO):** Services related to inspection, repair and maintenance of aircraft and aviation equipment.
 
• **India–France Strategic Partnership:** A bilateral framework enhancing cooperation in defence, space, technology, skill development and innovation sectors.
